set.body:
Three items where the documentation promises more than the exported surface delivers, or less.

bd-01KZYS7XH6G12QV8EYT561EPS3 is the sharp one: of 80 exported functions exactly two touch a bridge, the constructor and reverse_bridge. Nothing consumes one, though .closed_neural_boundary exists internally at R/evidence-task.R:60. introduction.Rmd:248-281 is a full section that builds a bridge and ends.

THE PRECEDENT IS IN THE PACKAGE ALREADY. introduction.Rmd:243-246 states plainly that correlation, ranking and Fisher edge pipelines are not exported until an executable scale-qualified path exists. Apply that same sentence to bridges, or export a consumer. The current state - a documented section terminating in an object with nowhere to go - is the only option that is not defensible.

ACCEPTANCE: every capability the documentation demonstrates is either reachable from the exported surface or explicitly declared unavailable in 0.1, using the wording the package already uses one section earlier.
